title: Split-screen Freestyle: player 2 Reset returns to its own start
summary: In split-screen Freestyle, player 2's Reset used to send player 2 back to player 1's start point. It now returns player 2 to its own start slot, ten feet beside player 1. Races are unchanged.
details: Confirmed in the browser before the fix: after Reset, player 2 sat about 0.1 ft from player 1's start. Second::load now records player 2's own slot as its reset start through a new Ride::set_start_pose. PR #524, closes #508. Verification: test_engine_split_screen.mjs failed before the change and passes after (one known #491 flake on the first run); make precheck passes.
limitation: The original game's split-screen start slots were not traced, so the ten-foot slot is a port choice. No unit test, because the check needs game content. Host-only; not checked on a phone..
